g.text: 1. Passes shown schematically (convection + radiant in series); 4 identical passes, coil steam per pass.
2. Pass flow SIS transmitters FT-200xA/B/C (2oo3) independent of BPCS FT-200x (SIF-201).
3. Vacuum off-gas burned in dedicated H-201 burners via flame arrestor (from D-202 / PV-2031).
4. Natural draft heater: O2 trim AIC-2008 on stack damper.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
14.7 MW abs. / 17.5 MW fired; 1-cell cabin, 4 passes, 44 rad. tubes 6" x
MAT'L Tubes A335 P9 (9Cr-1Mo); convection P5 / CS studded
H-201 low-low pass flow -> trip fuel
H-201 low-low FG pressure / flame failure -> t
